misprints.note: Aorist infinitive printed with a circumflex on η.

uncertain.note: In the print the τ of δυνατῶν looks like a broken τ without its crossbar, so it could also be read as ι (δυναιῶν). I transcribed it as δυνατῶν.
The full stop after Förmåga is very faint.
The mark over ω could be rough breathing plus acute (ὥς). I transcribed it as ὡς.
